desc:
⭐ Welcome to Build A +1 Keyboard Escape!

😀 Add obstacles to create your escape
💰 Earn cash from NPCs completing it
🔨 Expand and improve your base
🔄 Rebirth to unlock new areas and upgrades
🏆 Play through your own escape and reach the finish!

Game is new, so there may be some bugs.

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards!
